svg.text: L-SIAMS Classroom Terminal — Wiring and Connectivity
ESP32-WROOM-32 on an expansion board, mounted with the MFRC522 and AS608 on a universal PCB
UNIVERSAL PCB · perfboard substrate carrying the 3V3 and GND rails
breaks out every GPIO · distributes 3V3 and GND
13.56 MHz RFID reader · SPI · 3.3 V only

• The fingerprint UART is crossed on purpose. The sensor's TX goes to GPIO 17, which is where the ESP32 listens. Wired straight through, both ends transmit, neither listens, and the sensor never answers with no error shown anywhere.

• The MFRC522 is 3.3 V only, and 5 V destroys a bare AS608. Both modules share the ESP32's single 3V3 pin, so join the two power wires to each other and run one wire to the pin rather than stacking two solder joints on it.
• Fit 100 µF and 100 nF across 3V3 and GND at each module. The MFRC522's transmit burst browns out the rail without them.
